analysis.one_line_summary: Receipt-themed Black Friday graphic promoting the Wavytalk Defined Volume Duo bundle for $125 with 37% off.
analysis.full_description: A square graphic designed as a stylized crumpled paper receipt against a dark maroon textured background. At the top of the receipt, the Wavytalk logo and 'Black Friday' appear, followed by a bold price callout of '$125.00 | 37% OFF' and a pill sticker reading 'You save: $73.00'. Below, a line item breakdown lists 'DEFINED VOLUME DUO Blowout Boost + Whirlwind Curl' with quantity 1. In the lower section, studio cutouts of the pink thermal round brush (Blowout Boost) and the pink airflow/flat styler (Whirlwind Curl) are displayed side by side. A dark circular badge on the right says 'TODAY ONLY', and barcode receipt corners frame the edges.

on_screen_text.text: DEFINED VOLUME DUO Blowout Boost + Whirlwind Curl 1

scenes.visual: A white crumpled receipt mockup over a deep plum/burgundy background. The receipt details the Black Friday price, bundle name, and showcases the pink Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush and Whirlwind Curl iron standing upright side by side.
